headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting very strong revenue gains while others saw modest or flat performance.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. LTM and Tech Mahindra also delivered double‑digit growth. Infosys and Wipro showed the weakest top‑line expansion, and Wipro's profit slipped. AI‑related revenue and deal wins were highlighted across most companies, but specific figures were limited.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Most firms cited AI as a key growth driver, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2%, while HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% outlook.
